title: Will-Call Merchandise and the Anniversary Review Spend
content:
**Branch pickup and the service level review — Ship-To Fulfillment Account.** Orders the customer collects at a Corbett branch counter are will-call shipments.

1. Will-call merchandise, the extended amount of shipped order lines shipped by will-call, counts at a share set by its weight in the ship-to's shipped merchandise of the last 12 months: where it is more than 30 percent of the extended amount of all the ship-to's shipped order lines of the 12 months it counts at 25 percent; where it is above 0.00 and at most 30 percent it counts at 50 percent; otherwise it counts in full.
2. Where will-call merchandise counts at a share below full, the uncounted part of it is taken out of the twelve-month spend and out of the six-month spend of the review, each over its own months, the share set by the 12-month weight applying to both.

**Basis Q&A**

*Which lines make up the weight?* Will-call merchandise of the 12 months compared with the extended amount of all shipped order lines of the same 12 months; backorder fill lines are not shipped order lines. A line is within N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from the review date.

*At 25 percent, how much is taken out?* The uncounted 75 percent of the will-call merchandise of each period.

*What happens when will-call merchandise is exactly 30 percent?* It is at most 30 percent, so it counts at 50 percent; anything more than 30 percent counts at 25 percent.

*And with no will-call lines?* Will-call merchandise of 0.00 counts in full, and nothing is taken out.

**Hypothetical illustration**

| Inputs | Figure |
|---|---|
| All shipped merchandise of the 12 months | 10000.00 |
| Will-call merchandise of the 12 months | 4000.00 (40 percent, more than 30) |
| Share counted | 25 percent |
| Taken out of the twelve-month spend | 3000.00 (the uncounted 75 percent of 4000.00) |
| Will-call merchandise within the 6 months | 2000.00 |
| Taken out of the six-month spend | 1500.00 |
